insights.title: Install mix — Where installs come from is shifting away from SEO Install (-15.5% vs -3.4% for installs overall).
insights.body: SEO Install was 14,355, -15.5% against last week, while total installs moved -3.4% — a difference of -12.1 percentage points. SEO Install is now 6.9% of all installs, so the balance between channels is moving away from it; free traffic slipping while paid holds up means we are buying more of the same installs..

insights.title: Market trend — DE is losing ground fast on turning installs into subs (-13.6%, now 14.9%).
insights.body: In DE, 14.9% of installs now turn into new subs — -13.6% versus last period. It is about 6% of revenue (a market worth watching): fewer of the people downloading are subscribing, and revenue will feel that within a week or two.
